info.name: Integrations and Support Webhook Endpoints API
info.description:
The Integrations and Support API defines endpoints for configuring integrations with Plaid, Flinks, Inverite, and Global Pay, managing API keys, and handling support tickets. It also includes endpoints for setting and testing webhook URLs, and fetching webhook notifications for account and partner accounts.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: help@vopay.com

request.description: This endpoint will retrieve your webhook URL.

urlencoded.description: The type of webhook notification you wish to receive. Options are: transaction, paylink, bankaccount, debitcard, creditcard, batchrequest, batchdetail, accountonboarding, accountonboardingapplication, scheduledtransactions, accountverifications, virtualtransaction. Default is transaction.
A custom JSON payload to send to the webhook URL. If not provided, a sample payload will be generated based on the Type parameter.

URL where the users want us to send their notifications. This parameter has to be a valid URL. If the field Disabled is added, this field can be optional; otherwise, it will consider as mandatory

The type of webhook notification the users wish to receive. Options are: transaction, paylink, bankaccount, debitcard, creditcard, batchrequest, batchdetail, accountonboarding, accountonboardingapplication, scheduledtransactions, accountverifications, virtualtransaction, virtualaccountcreated. If left blank changes will be applied to all webhook types.
If this parameter is present WebHookUrl is not mandatory.

request.description:
This endpoint will allow the user to add or modify a webhook URL.

The purpose of the webhook URL is to notify users of any changes in transaction status, paylink status, account status, account verification status, as well as bank account creation, scheduled transaction creation, batch request processed, and batch request failed.

request.description:
This endpoint will resend the webhook notification associated with the provided event ID. This is useful if you missed a webhook or if you need to reprocess a webhook.

The event ID can be fetched using the GET /account/webhooks endpoint.
